pharma.title: Tildrakizumab Clears Skin in Most Indian Psoriasis Patients in Phase III Trial
pharma.summary: Phase III clinical trial results demonstrated that Tildrakizumab successfully cleared skin in a significant majority of Indian psoriasis patients. The finding provides strong clinical support for its efficacy in dermatological care.
pharma.source_title: Tildrakizumab Clears Skin in Most Indian Psoriasis Patients in Phase III Trial - Bioengineer.org

pharma.title: Supreme Court Pulls Up Centre and Hospitals Over Excessive Drug Mark-Ups
pharma.summary: The Supreme Court strongly criticized severe hospital mark-ups on life-saving cancer drugs, labeling excessive price hikes as unfair exploitation. The apex court called on the central government to address drug overpricing.
pharma.source_title: SC pulls up Centre over soaring medicine costs - The Economic Times

pharma.title: India Drafts New Lab Animal Procurement Rules
pharma.summary: India published draft regulations governing lab animal procurement for scientific and pharmaceutical research. The update has garnered international attention regarding compliance standards for global trial partnerships.
pharma.source_title: Why new draft Indian rules for lab animal procurement matter to U.S. - Animals 24-7

national.title: Supreme Court Pushes for National Framework on Compulsory Rural Service by Doctors
national.summary: The Supreme Court advocated for a unified national policy regarding mandatory rural service for medical graduates. The framework aims to standardize healthcare service obligations across all states.
national.source_title: Supreme Court pushes for national framework on compulsory rural service by doctors | India News - Hindustan Times

national.title: India Invites Pakistan to SCO Forum in Delhi
national.summary: India extended an invitation to Pakistan for a Shanghai Cooperation Organisation (SCO) forum held in New Delhi. This marks a notable diplomatic engagement between the neighboring countries.
national.source_title: In a first since Operation Sindoor, India invites Pakistan for SCO forum in Delhi - India Today

national.title: UAPA Does Not Bar Bail for Foreigners Solely on Citizenship, Rules SC
national.summary: The Supreme Court clarified that foreign nationality alone does not disqualify an accused from obtaining bail under the Unlawful Activities (Prevention) Act (UAPA). The court stated that illegal entry and specific case merits remain primary considerations.
national.source_title: UAPA does not bar bail for all foreigners; illegal entry is key, rules SC | India News - Hindustan Times

national.title: Media Groups Challenge New Data Privacy Rules in Supreme Court
national.summary: Several Indian news and media organizations filed petitions in the Supreme Court questioning new data privacy regulations. The legal challenge addresses potential impacts on press freedom and operational compliance.
national.source_title: India media groups challenge new data privacy rules in top court - myRepublica

international.title: PM Modi Holds Bilateral Meetings at India AI Impact Summit
international.summary: Prime Minister Narendra Modi conducted bilateral talks with global leaders on the sidelines of the India AI Impact Summit. Discussions focused on artificial intelligence ethics, technological exchange, and global innovation partnerships.
international.source_title: PM Modi holds bilateral meetings with several world leaders on sidelines of India AI Impact Summit - News On AIR

international.title: India and Liechtenstein Strengthen Bilateral Relations
international.summary: India and Liechtenstein held high-level discussions aimed at expanding diplomatic cooperation. Key topics included strategic economic ties and international financial cooperation.
international.source_title: India and Liechtenstein Strengthen Diplomatic Relations - India News Network

international.title: India and Azerbaijan Reset Relations to Boost Energy and Connectivity
international.summary: India and Azerbaijan agreed to enhance bilateral engagement by expanding investments in energy infrastructure. Both countries emphasized improving regional transport and trade connectivity.
international.source_title: India, Azerbaijan move to reset ties, boost energy investments and connectivity - The Economic Times

economy.title: India Within Striking Distance of 8% Economic Growth, Says RBI Governor
economy.summary: Reserve Bank of India Governor Shaktikanta Das stated that ongoing structural reforms position India to achieve near 8% annual growth. He reiterated that economic fundamentals remain robust despite global volatility.
economy.source_title: India in striking distance of 8% growth as reforms boost economy: Shaktikanta Das - The Economic Times

economy.title: RBI Measures Reduce Record Banking System Liquidity Surplus
economy.summary: India's record surplus in bank cash liquidity began to taper off following strategic RBI interventions. The central bank's actions aimed to regulate speculative rupee trading and stabilize market liquidity.
economy.source_title: India’s record bank cash surplus fades as RBI curbs rupee bets - The Economic Times

economy.title: Credit Card Additions Reach Yearly Peak Ahead of Festive Season
economy.summary: Indian commercial banks reported their second-highest monthly credit card additions of 2026. The surge reflects heightened consumer sentiment and promotional efforts leading into the festive season.
economy.source_title: Credit card additions hit second-highest monthly level in 2026 as banks gear up for festive season - The Economic Times

science.title: PM Modi Inaugurates ESTIC 2026 Summit
science.summary: Prime Minister Narendra Modi inaugurated the Emerging Science, Technology and Innovation Conclave (ESTIC 2026). During his address, he emphasized India's shift from technology adoption to global technological leadership.
science.source_title: Prime Minister Shri Narendra Modi inaugurates Emerging Science, Technology and Innovation Conclave 2026 - India Education Diary

environment.title: Lancet Report Highlights 36% Rise in Global Heat-Linked Deaths
environment.summary: A report published in The Lancet indicated a 36% rise in climate-linked heat fatalities globally since the Paris Agreement. The study listed India among the most affected nations, highlighting high heat exposure risks for vulnerable demographics.
environment.source_title: Climate-linked heat deaths rise 36% since Paris Agreement; India also affected: Lancet | India News - Hindustan Times

environment.title: Cyclone Arnab Makes Landfall in Andhra Pradesh
environment.summary: Cyclone Arnab made landfall along the Andhra Pradesh coastline, triggering severe winds and torrential rainfall. Emergency response teams carried out extensive evacuations across coastal zones.
environment.source_title: Cyclone Arnab makes landfall in Andhra Pradesh as India's east coast braces for severe winds - streamlinefeed.co.ke

sports.title: Mirabai Chanu Wins India's First Gold at Commonwealth Games 2026
sports.summary: Star weightlifter Mirabai Chanu secured India's first gold medal at the Commonwealth Games 2026. Her victory opened India's gold medal tally in the weightlifting discipline.
sports.source_title: Mirabai Chanu wins India’s first gold at Commonwealth Games 2026 in weightlifting | Akashvani News - News On AIR

sports.title: India Defeats Bangladesh 13-0 in Asian Champions Trophy Opener
sports.summary: The Indian hockey team initiated its Asian Champions Trophy defense with a commanding 13-0 win over Bangladesh. The dominant victory highlighted strong offensive performances across all quarters.
sports.source_title: India Begin Asian Champions Trophy Title Defence With Dominant 13-0 Win Over Bangladesh - IndiaSportsHub

awards_honours.title: UAE President Honours Indian Pilot Captain Smit Machchhar for Bravery
awards_honours.summary: The President of the United Arab Emirates conferred an honor upon Indian pilot Captain Smit Machchhar and his flight team. The recognition was awarded for their heroic composure and courage during a mid-air emergency.
awards_honours.source_title: UAE honours Indian flydubai pilot Smit Machchhar, crew for bravery during cockpit attack - PTC News

defence.title: Rajnath Singh Meets US Defense Secretary Pete Hegseth at ASEAN Forum
defence.summary: Defence Minister Rajnath Singh held bilateral discussions with US Secretary of Defense Pete Hegseth on the sidelines of the ASEAN Defense Ministers' Meeting. The leaders reviewed key initiatives under the India-US Defence Framework.
defence.source_title: Rajnath Singh holds talks with Pete Hegseth on sidelines of Asean meet - Business Standard

defence.title: Defence Ministry Highlights Self-Reliance as Key to National Security
defence.summary: The Ministry of Defence underscored progress in domestic defense manufacturing under national self-reliance initiatives. Enhanced indigenous production capabilities continue to strengthen operational readiness.
defence.source_title: India's Defence Strength Powering National Security through Self-Reliance - Press Information Bureau

schemes_appointments.title: Centre Announces National Hydrocarbon Technology Hub at ETM 2026
schemes_appointments.summary: The Ministry of Petroleum and Natural Gas announced the establishment of the National Hydrocarbon Technology Hub during ETM 2026. The hub aims to boost indigenous research and technological innovation in energy sectors.
schemes_appointments.source_title: ETM 2026: Centre Announces National Hydrocarbon Technology Hub - Sarkaritel.com

schemes_appointments.title: Panel Constituted to Review Pharmaceutical Marketing Code (UCPMP)
schemes_appointments.summary: The Central Government formed a three-member expert committee to review the Uniform Code for Pharmaceutical Marketing Practices (UCPMP). The panel will evaluate steps toward strengthening the legal framework governing pharma promotions.
schemes_appointments.source_title: Centre Sets Up Three-Member Panel to Review Pharma Marketing Code UCPMP, Weigh Stronger Legal Framework - eHealth Magazine

mcqs.q: Cyclone Arnab made landfall along the coastline of which Indian state in October 2026?
mcqs.explanation: Cyclone Arnab made landfall along the coastal region of Andhra Pradesh, causing heavy rains and necessitating mass evacuations.

mcqs.q: Who won India's first gold medal at the Commonwealth Games 2026?
mcqs.explanation: Weightlifter Mirabai Chanu clinched India's first gold medal at the Commonwealth Games 2026.

mcqs.q: Which drug showed significant skin clearance in Indian psoriasis patients during Phase III clinical trials reported in October 2026?
mcqs.explanation: Tildrakizumab demonstrated high efficacy in skin clearance for psoriasis patients during Phase III clinical trials in India.

mcqs.q: What major technological facility did the Centre announce during the Energy Technology Meet (ETM 2026)?
mcqs.explanation: The government announced the establishment of the National Hydrocarbon Technology Hub during ETM 2026 to foster energy research.
